content: Yook ambo bi ye karub yeman. Nongbed wangki yemaniib. Dewid ye yook.

content.text: O ne nen koromone dorondandi ye God,
eb yaa baandaka inanduwe.
Ne dabab aom wanaan kuu ebbed awawi kawewen.
Kowe, ne yaa mimyob keeweneb ne kurikuri wengambere.
O karuwa nimaya, yiib kuu aron komoyiibbed naningko nambiriyiib yaa damangkawembaraniib?
Yiib kuu aron komoyiibbed idiibban yeman yaa dowakeniib kerenib iranmi yeman yaa onmembaraniib? Selah
Kumban kaadkerime! Yariman kuu ye kiwaan arimo doriibdan kuu ben yeka ye dowad angkara nongkoboon.
Kowe, nembed Yariman yaa baandaniin kuu wengamberewaneen.
Uniyiib kiringmime, ambarakmaib.
Yiib angkimbon ari angkibka,
yiib mimyob aom andangke darobe iwari kerime. Selah
Yorokmo ye munob koni yeman konime,
Yariman yaamo angkumone dobirime.
Nimakarub yemoonbed yedmimaib, “Kanembed nub yaa amun kerundaneen? Dowan!” andimaib.
O Yariman, eb murubia ye nambiri kuu nub yaa nambere yurok.
Ne niindem aom kuu ebbed kubi darewoob onduknewewen.
Kuu yimbed animan id yemoon ire wanabe wain ok yemoon ongmenib kubimaib kuu burudande arimbed kawewen.
Ne yiri angkimain kuu yewenubmo unuk angkimain,
amborom kuu o Yariman,
ebbedmo ne nen kangkurudmo kebene oonewimaab.
